findings.claim: Iterated Dold–Kan target and normalization convention comparison lack explicit nonnegative-per-direction hypotheses; reversal/sign comparison is not constructed and grouping wording risks conflating simplicial diagonal with chain total.
findings.repair: Saved theorem states nonnegative chain degrees, proves Moore normalization via explicit projection and degenerate quotient, iterates in abelian functor categories, and restricts regrouping to chain directions.
findings.adverse: The true iterated Dold–Kan equivalence does not depend on the false strict unnormalized identity and should be preserved.

findings.claim: Strict associativity of shuffle and coassociativity of AW.
findings.rationale: Both shuffle orders enumerate the same three-type words with the same inversion parity; both AW orders use identical consecutive front/middle/back cuts. This does not establish coherence of chosen homotopies.

proof_audit.chain_maps: Finite integral operator identities checked by cut-boundary cancellation for AW and adjacent-path cancellation for shuffle. Same-axis vertex deletion produces the horizontal sign (-1)^a or signed vertical sign (-1)^(p+b), including endpoints.
proof_audit.models: M^{p,q}_{a,b}=Z[Hom([a],[p])×Hom([b],[q])]. Diagonal model contracts by prepending (0,0). Total model is CΔ[p]⊗CΔ[q], contracting by h_p⊗1+e_p⊗h_q (graded tensor convention; second term supported in horizontal degree0).
proof_audit.homotopy_recursion: For L=Sh AW−1 and L=AW Sh−1 separately, H_{−1}=H_0=0. At a universal generator z of degree n>0 set r=L_n(z)−H_{n−1}(dz), H_n(z)=K(r). The previous-degree equation and d²=0 give dr=0; model positive-degree acyclicity gives dK(r)=r. Extend the finite operator expression universally, giving dH+Hd=L in every additive category.
proof_audit.no_target_tensor_hypothesis: Free abelian groups and tensor products are used only to calculate universal integral formulas, not assumed to exist in the target additive category.
proof_audit.normalization: Saved P_m=(1−s_0d_1)...(1−s_{m−1}d_m), rightmost first, removes faces in descending order, is identity on ∩_{i>0}ker d_i, kills degeneracies, and differs from identity by degeneracies. Thus the Moore subcomplex identifies with the degenerate quotient and hence with native Stacks normalization. Distinct-direction projectors commute; their product gives intersection image and sum-of-degenerate-kernels kernel.
proof_audit.proof_status: The existing saved correction provides an all-degree mathematical proof, independently checked here. Finite regression is supplementary; no theorem is certified merely by compilation.

normalized_distinction.scope: Explanation only; not an extra theorem silently added to the recovered patch.
normalized_distinction.quotient_setting: In an abelian category normalize by quotienting degenerate chains, in both directions for the total and diagonally for the diagonal complex.
normalized_distinction.strict_identity: AWbar Shbar=1 on the normalized total.
normalized_distinction.strict_identity_reason: For input bidegree(p,q) and output(a,b) with a+b=p+q, if a>p or b>q the corresponding composite factors through a degeneracy. When(a,b)=(p,q), only the block path of p horizontal then q vertical steps is nondegenerate, and it contributes identity with sign+1.
normalized_distinction.descent_reason: Shuffle sends an input degeneracy to a diagonal degeneracy at the path step crossing the repeated coordinate. AW sends a diagonal degeneracy into a horizontal or vertical degeneracy depending on the cut.
normalized_distinction.caveat: This vanishing occurs modulo degeneracies, not by unnormalized cancellation. Do not claim unprojected AW automatically lands in the native kernel-normalization model or that the newly chosen unnormalized H automatically descends. Normalized homotopy compatibility is a separate result.
